newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - DEC 19.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - DEC 19.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:

- In the government's last session of the year it decided to raise medicine proces by 12 percent and to allocate one billion forints to compensate poorer sections of the population for January energy price increases.
- As police search for the killer of a business man on Wednesday night, Budapest City Council accepted the nomination of Attila Barta as the new Budapest police chief.
- Parliament's closing session saw heavy opposition criticism of the government's 1996 record.
- Trade union federation MSZOSZ was rumoured to be reviewing its relations with the government in its closed session.
A parliamentary investigation committee has completed its findings into Russian-Hungarian oil deliveries and will submit the report to Parliament.
